name: Appetite for Blood raises Bloodfang Bite damage against Humanoids and Beasts (#2010)
contract: Appetite for Blood 560479 has one effect: aura 112 (SPELL_AURA_OVERRIDE_CLASS_SCRIPTS), MiscValue 20014, MiscValueB 65, BasePoints 19 / DieSides 1, i.e. 20%, class mask (0, 8388608, 16384) = Bloodfang Bite, Claw Sweep and Crimson Maw. Unit::GetCreatureTypeMask returns 1 << (type - 1), so 65 is CREATURE_TYPE_BEAST (1) plus CREATURE_TYPE_HUMANOID (64) - exactly the tooltip's 'Humanoids and Beasts'. The native bonus that expresses this is aura 168 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_DONE_VERSUS (Unit.cpp:8823 and Unit.cpp:10730), which ignores the effect's class mask, so the conversion keeps the selector in MiscValueB and the core honours the mask for those rows only. 572551 is the Bloodfang Bite rank a level-80 character owns; it is DmgClass 2, so melee_spell_damage_done (Unit::MeleeDamageBonusDone) is its damage path. Creature templates: 27228 Jormungar Worm is type 1 (Beast), 27434 Winterfin First Responder is type 7 (Humanoid) and 36 Harvest Golem is type 9 (Mechanical), the control.
